name: prepare-handover-docs
description: Build a client-handover Google Doc for a mobile app — one native tab per area (env, Firebase, App Store, Play Store, release & rollback, overview). Detects the current project and fills every tab from the repo plus a few things only you know, one step at a time, confirming before each write. React Native (default) and Expo (the -expo skill). No secret values ever enter the doc.
